title: Indigestion

inlines.v: INDIGES'TION, noun [in and digestion.] Want of due coction in the stomach; a failure of that change in food which prepares it for nutriment; crudity. As a disease, dyspepsy; that state of the stomach, in which it is incapable of performing its natural healthy functions.
